title: AuthProvider invalid-header panic only in WS path, not HTTP
description: AuthProvider::auth_header doc says returning invalid HTTP field values 'will cause a panic in the WebSocket connection path'. The HTTP paths (fetch_session, call, upload_blob, download_blob) use reqwest which accepts the same strings without panicking. A custom AuthProvider that passes reqwest but violates RFC 9110 will silently work over HTTP and panic only when connect_ws is called — a confusing asymmetry that will generate bug reports saying 'my auth works but WebSocket panics'. The contract asymmetry is undocumented at the trait level in a way callers can act on.
